units: metres, unit plane normals and unit target ray
tie_break: lowest photometric loss, then candidate id
unique_threshold: Select only if exactly one candidate has at least N-K interval votes; otherwise retain incumbent and explicitly abstain.
singular_interval: If abs(n_hat dot ray) <= eps_normal, support every candidate as an uninformative interval; never clip its radius.
truth_isolation: generate.py writes observed inputs and private evaluation truth separately; select.py imports neither generator nor evaluator and never reads truth; evaluate.py verifies the sealed input/decision/code hashes before reading truth.
scope: CPU synthetic mechanism constructions only; no real data, historical errors, or official geometry are read. No claim of empirical error calibration.
